description: The bar chart, titled "Defending Against Social Engineering Attacks in the Age of LLMs," illustrates the number of conversations across four different domains—Academic Collaboration, Recruitment, Academic Funding, and Journalism—categorized by the level of deception, as indicated by the legend: "Deceived" with "Yes" (maroon), "Partially" (olive green), and "No" (dark green). The horizontal axis represents the "Number of Conversations," ranging from 0 to 60, while the vertical axis lists the four domains. The data shows that in the "Academic Funding" category, the "Yes" (maroon) bar is the longest, extending to approximately 65, indicating the highest number of conversations where deception was successful. In "Journalism," the "Partially" (olive green) bar is the longest, reaching about 48. For "Recruitment," the "Yes" (maroon) bar is the longest, at approximately 38. In "Academic Collaboration," the "Partially" (olive green) bar is the longest, at about 27. The "No" (dark green) category has the shortest bars across all domains, with the longest being in "Academic Collaboration" at approximately 7. The chart visually emphasizes that deception is most prevalent in the "Academic Funding" domain, followed by "Journalism" and "Recruitment," with the least deception occurring in "Academic Collaboration."
